_comment: An EXANTE gateway: one process per EXANTE account owns the two FIX sessions (FEED for quotes, TRADE for orders, with CancelOnDisconnect) and the HTTP API key (polled reads: account summary, positions, orders, fills, fees); the bots lease it. 'network' is demo or live; 'fix_host' the FIX bridge (demo: fixuat2.exante.eu; live: the one EXANTE assigned, e.g. fixprodeu.exante.eu). 'symbols' are EXANTE ids (XAU/USD.E.FX, AAPL.NASDAQ, GC.COMEX.Z2026). 'tif' DAY is what CancelOnDisconnect cancels. EXANTE allows 25 order requests per 10 s: msgs_per_min stays at or under 150.
name: exante_demo
